title: BTS, Madonna & Shakira Confirmed as 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show Co-Headliners
detail: On May 14, 2026, FIFA officially confirms BTS, Madonna, and Shakira as co-headliners for the first-ever halftime show at the FIFA World Cup Final, scheduled for July 19, 2026 at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The announcement was made through the World Cup's official Instagram account with a teaser video curated by Global Citizen, which aims to raise $100 million for the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund. CNN, the Washington Post, Billboard, and CNBC all report on the confirmation. HYBE's stock surged 7.2% on the Korea Exchange following the announcement, adding approximately 700 billion won (~$470 million USD) to the company's market capitalization in a single session — the largest single-day HYBE stock movement of 2026. The halftime show marks BTS's entry into one of the highest-profile entertainment events in the world, appearing alongside international icons Madonna and Shakira in what would be BTS's second major 2026 performance at MetLife Stadium.

media.caption: BTS, Madonna, and Shakira confirmed as co-headliners for the 2026 FIFA World Cup Final halftime show at MetLife Stadium, July 19

title: BTS Arrives in Bay Area Ahead of Stanford Stadium Debut; ARMY Wave Documented by Local Press
detail: On May 14, 2026, BTS arrives in the San Francisco Bay Area ahead of three sold-out shows at Stanford Stadium (May 16, 17, and 19). The Almanac, a Palo Alto-area community newspaper, publishes 'Permission to dance: BTS brings a joyful ARMY to Stanford,' documenting the wave of fans already descending on the peninsula. The piece highlights the logistical scale of BTS fan arrivals in Northern California and the historical significance of Stanford Stadium hosting only its second-ever rock/pop concert act after Coldplay. KQED's Bay Area guide for the Stanford shows notes the clear bag policy, 4:30 PM gate times, and 7:00 PM show times across all three sold-out nights. The Bay Area arrival comes one day after news of the ARIRANG World Tour's $1.8 billion revenue projection and alongside the FIFA World Cup halftime show announcement, making May 14 the most news-dense day for BTS in 2026.

media.caption: BTS arrives in Bay Area; ARMY fans flood the Palo Alto peninsula ahead of three Stanford Stadium shows, May 14, 2026
